summary: rec.gov + FS read: $15, 18 nonelectric sites (3 tent-only, max 40 ft, paved), 10 reservable late May-Labor Day with a 4-day cutoff, the rest first-come; 2027 season 04-29 to 10-12. Lakefront -> not waterfront lead (sites 50-80 m back in forest, no water in any site photo). Pin ~290 m off at the day-use road.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD: stored lakefront -> not waterfront (not an --AWH value). On the RIDB site points the nearest RV site, 18 (45.93744,-89.06004), is ~75 m from Anvil Lake and site 15 (45.93789,-89.05959) ~80 m; the nearest of all are tent sites 16 and 17 (~50 m). Everything between is continuous maple-hemlock forest on a slope ('perched above Anvil Lake'). The rec.gov photos of 13, 14, 15, 16, 17 and 18 (taken leaf-off) show woods and no water. The stored waterfront_evidence ('docks at the waterline on the east side of the loop') describes the day-use/beach shoreline, not the campsites.
PIN MOVE (>250 m): stored 45.9359,-89.0622 sits on the day-use/beach access road SW of the campground; the site centroid is 45.9376,-89.0594 (~290 m NE). Suggest 45.9375,-89.0594.
SEASON: 2027 runs 04-29 to 10-12 (rec.gov rate seasons); stored 04-30/10-13 is the 2026 calendar.
